_note: Weapons Menu options (manual L2074-L2142 table) + per-weapon starting-count rows DERIVED from the real weapons catalog (data/weapons.json, manual:L959-L995). The per-weapon rows have no manual definition (the manual filters availability via Arms Level/Useless Items only) — they are task-directed, marked _derived, never presented as manual transcriptions. STORAGE-ONLY this leaf (T-UI-2): wiring (blast radius, trails, projectile visuals) is a later leaf; every row carries wired:false. Note: armsLevel here (range 0-4, default 4, manual:L2077) is the Weapons Menu OPTION; the weapons.json per-weapon armsLevel column is catalog data and is NOT duplicated as a setting.

armsLevel.label: Arms Level
armsLevel.description: Disallow the use of items above this Arms Level. 0 = beginners, fewer options.
armsLevel._wired: T-UI-3: consumer = createBattle economy.armsLevel (inventory.buy + checkChoose 'arms' gate) + store open playOptions; read from stored 'se.settings' at battle creation

bombIcon.label: Bomb icon
bombIcon.description: Projectile look when fired: no dot, slightly larger dot, or no dot at all.
bombIcon._wired: W2-E: consumer = src/ui/weaponVisuals.js applyBombIcon — the enum drives the #top-weapon bomb icon element's size from visual.sizesPx (INVISIBLE hides it). Wired at weaponPicker mount + settings APPLY.

tunneling.label: Tunneling
tunneling.description: OFF: weapons explode on hitting dirt. ON: they tunnel in, maybe out the other side.
tunneling._wired: T-UI-3: consumer = makeTunnelBehavior.onTerrainHit (src/gameplay/behaviors/heavy.js) — OFF detonates at first dirt contact

scale.label: Scale
scale.description: Scale up so weapons are more destructive than usual.
scale._wired: T-UI-3 + W5 purge: consumer = projectiles3d blast conversion (rWorld multiplier read from THIS magnitudes block; MEDIUM 1.5 / LARGE 2 _placeholder — manual pins none)

tracePaths.label: Trace Paths
tracePaths.description: Each projectile leaves a trail in the firing tank's color.
tracePaths._wired: W2-E: consumer = systems/tracePaths.js (registered at runtime by src/ui/weaponVisuals.ensureTracePathsSystem). ON = every airborne projectile3d entity spawns throttled trace fx entities, color = data/weapons.json visual.traceColor (per weapon class), decay via the fx_decay script pattern. OFF = zero trace entities (pinned).

extraDirt.label: Extra Dirt
extraDirt.description: Controls how much dirt Dirt Charges let out. Fun but can slow the game down.
extraDirt._wired: T-UI-3: consumer = earthHit -> dirtDeposit scale (dirt_charge ridge radius x2, _placeholder magnitude; manual pins none)

uselessItems.label: Useless Items
uselessItems.description: If OFF, items with no effect on the game (given current options) are hidden from the buying menu.
uselessItems._wired: W2-E: consumer = src/ui/store.js + src/ui/weaponPicker.js filter (filterUselessWeapons). OFF = weapons the current player CANNOT use (arms-level gating, buyBlock 'arms') are HIDDEN from the store weapon column and the picker; ON = all rows shown (blocked rows greyed with the reason). Cash-blocked rows are never hidden by this filter.
